init_BaseILTrainer: create a BaseILTrainer instance with a DictConfig to initialize the imitation learning trainer
save_checkpoint: save a model state_dict as a checkpoint file to the configured checkpoint folder
eval_checkpoint: evaluate a single checkpoint using a TensorboardWriter for logging metrics
make_dirs: create directories for log files, checkpoints, and evaluation results
set_flush_secs: set the flush interval in seconds for the tensorboard writer logging
